{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Foreign aid must serve America's interests first.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"International assistance is a critical tool for advancing America's security and economic interests by preventing conflict, building stability, opening markets for private investment, and responding to suffering and need.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A strong commitment to international development and diplomacy, alongside defense, was a key component of President Reagan's \"peace through strength\" strategy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"International assistance can sometimes serve as an alternative means of keeping the peace, far less costly both in dollars and in human lives than military engagement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Millennium Challenge Corporation, spearheaded by the last Republican Administration, has established a new model of foreign assistance that helps ensure taxpayer dollars are spent on projects that are effective, results-driven, transparent, and accountable.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for embracing the Millennium Challenge Corporation model throughout foreign assistance programs and efforts as a catalyst for private sector investment to combat corruption, strengthen the rule of law, and open new markets for American goods and services in a competitive global economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Foreign assistance programs must project the best of American values and work to create self-sustainability and leverage the resources and capacity of the private sector.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Overseas assistance—billions of dollars and volunteer hours—is provided by America's foundations, educational institutions, faith-based groups, and charitable individuals.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
